summary: Log4Shell RCE in payments-api logging dependency
description: The payments-api service bundles a vulnerable Log4j version. The endpoint is internet-facing and processes cardholder data, so a crafted request header can trigger remote code execution. Flagged by the dependency scanner on the public payments edge.

summary: xz-utils backdoor present in auth-service base image
description: The auth-service container base image ships a backdoored xz-utils build. This is the original finding for this CVE and is tracked to resolution here. Internet-facing authentication surface.

summary: xz-utils backdoor flagged again in reporting-ui image
description: The same xz-utils backdoor was flagged in the reporting-ui build. This service is internal, behind SSO. Expected to be recognised as a duplicate of the auth-service finding for the same CVE.

summary: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset DoS on auth-service gateway
description: The auth-service gateway is vulnerable to the HTTP/2 Rapid Reset attack. The listener is public-facing, so an attacker can exhaust server resources with rapid stream cancellation.

summary: Spring framework data-binding flaw in payments-api
description: A scanner flagged this CVE on the internet-facing payments-api but did not report a severity or a CVSS score. Verdict should gap-fill the score from NVD and prioritise accordingly.

summary: Heap over-read in zlib used by reporting-ui
description: A low-severity heap over-read in a zlib routine used by the internal reporting-ui. The service is internal only, not internet-facing, and the affected path is not reachable from user input.

summary: Possible insecure deserialization reported by pentester
description: A pentester noted possible insecure deserialization somewhere in the stack but did not attach a CVE, a CVSS score, a severity, or the affected service. Verdict should decline to prioritise and ask a human to add the missing detail.
